title: ATTP Corporate Day 2025 – a season review and a community celebration
body_html:
The National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players of the Republic of Moldova (ATTP) held its traditional annual corporate event outdoors, with around 100 amateur and professional players, members and friends of the community taking part.

The gathering blended the official part — presenting the activity report for the 2024–2025 season and highlighting its main achievements — with a rich leisure programme designed to strengthen the bonds between participants.

The festive atmosphere was livened up by table-tennis-themed contests, symbolic gifts, dancing and music, bringing plenty of good humour and positive emotions.

The organisers stressed that the event was not only a look back at ATTP’s successes but also a way to strengthen team spirit and community solidarity. “These gatherings express our unity and our shared wish to build a better future for table tennis in the Republic of Moldova,” the association’s representatives said.

ATTP Corporate Day 2025 thus became a symbol of cohesion and continuity, combining the review of a busy season with the joy of being together.
